p: This is a Coast Sand-treader Cricket, Rhachocnemis validus, from Morro Bay. I specifically went out looking for this one. It has these spurs on its hind legs is uses for digging, and it leaves a tread when it walks around, hence, "Sand-treader". When I finally got these shots, I was over the moon. I felt like I captured a beautiful slice of its life, a little cricket that lives a life on the beach. Dune bugs > dune buggies. Stop destroying our dune ecosystems, they're beyond wonderful.
